headline: Amazon Autos to launch car sales in UK in early 2027
summary: Amazon Autos will begin selling cars in the UK in early 2027, its first expansion outside the US, launching with vehicles from South Korean automaker Hyundai in a move that could disrupt Britain's roughly £200bn vehicle retail market.

claims.statement: Amazon Autos will begin selling cars in the UK in early 2027, its first market outside the US.

sources.quote: Amazon Autos is coming to the UK in its first expansion outside the US
The Amazon Autos service will be launched in “early 2027”, starting with cars from the Korean manufacturer

claims.statement: The launch will start with vehicles from Hyundai, a South Korean automaker, in a market worth roughly £200bn.
